signals.text: Gap up in the bias direction with a tight overnight range — trend-day conditions; the first ORB break long carries the setup.
FTSE is tracking a firmer European tape (Euro Stoxx +0.35%) — the cross-market lean is up.
Sterling is at the 5th percentile of its 20-day range and falling — a weak-GBP tailwind for the index's dollar earners.
GBP is a crowded short — a short-squeeze higher in sterling is a latent slap for upside breaks (strong GBP weighs on FTSE).
